title: Macklemore hits back with 'Free Palestine Tour' after Sheeran split
summary: US rapper Macklemore, who was dropped from British pop star Ed Sheeran's tour after making pro-Palestinian comments, announced Thursday he will instead perform on his own "Free Palestine Tour."
